title: Delta-stream bulk embeddings ingest with checkpointed retry protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Customers ingest large embedding datasets from a mixture of streaming sources (change-delta feeds) and periodic bulk uploads. Current controllers support either streaming or batch-only import patterns and can struggle with late-arriving records, duplicate retries, and cost-latency tradeoffs when small updates arrive frequently. This ticket implements a delta-stream ingestion mode — a hybrid API that accepts a continuous stream of change events and also supports large-range bulk backfills via the same job abstraction. Key features: checkpointed retry protocol for idempotency, windowed sparse-batching to reduce GPU load, late-arrival conciliator to reconcile out-of-order updates, and an async job API with deterministic job IDs for replay and audit.
acceptance_criteria: API: New POST /v1/embeddings/delta-stream job that returns a stable job_id and accepts ChangeRecords with optional idempotency_key.
Idempotency: Submitting the same batch with the same job_id + chunk_sequence must be deduplicated (at-most-once semantics) and safe across retries.
Checkpointing: Each ingest worker persists checkpoints (job_id, chunk_sequence, last_vector_offset) to durable store; restarting a worker resumes from the last checkpoint.

Late-arrival handling: Records older than current checkpoint but newer than last-vector-offset are routed to conciliator flow and either update or tombstone existing vectors depending on transform rules.
Throughput: End-to-end ingestion pipeline sustains 20k vectors/sec on current dedicated capacity profile with 95th percentile latency for final commit under 10s for typical chunk sizes.
Failures & Retries: Transient failures trigger exponential-backoff retries up to configured attempts; permanent duplicates are not reprocessed and produce a de-duplication audit entry.
Monitoring: Dashboards show job-level throughput, checkpoint lag, retry counts, conciliator replays, and cost-per-1000 vectors; alerts fire on checkpoint lag > 5 minutes.
Documentation: SDK examples (Python + Node) and Console job view exist; PRD and API spec updated.
E2E tests: Integration tests for resume-after-crash, idempotent retries, and late-arrival reconciliation pass in CI with synthetic workloads.
implementation_plan: API design: Define request schema for ChangeRecord (id, source_ts, operation{upsert,delete}, payload, idempotency_key) and job lifecycle endpoints (create/start/status/cancel).
Controller: Implement DeltaStreamJob runner that shards input by source namespace and assigns chunk_sequence tokens for ordering guarantees.
Worker: Add CheckpointStore abstraction (backed by DynamoDB/postgres) to persist (job_id, shard, chunk_seq, last_offset).
Batching: Implement sparse-window batching: accumulate updates for a short adaptive window (configurable 50-250ms) and form GPU batches that respect sequence locality.
Conciliator: Build late-arrival conciliator process which compares source_ts + existing vector ts to decide update vs ignore; produce audit log for conflicts.
Idempotency: Use (job_id, shard, chunk_sequence, idempotency_key) as dedupe key in a write-once append store; ensure idempotency metadata is compacted periodically.
Retries: Add client-visible retry headers and implement server-side idempotent retry path with idempotency TTL configurable per workspace.
Backpressure: Hook into routing to expose advisory backpressure signals (routed to SDK) when GPU queue depth exceeds thresholds.
Console/UI: Add job listing, per-job timeline, and per-shard checkpoint visualization; attach links to audit logs and reconcile diffs.
Rollout: Canary on internal dedicated cluster with synthetic delta feeds, followed by opt-in beta customers before full rollout.
testing_plan: Unit tests for CheckpointStore read/write and compaction semantics.
Integration tests: simulate worker crash and restart to validate resume semantics; verify no duplicates after repeated retries.
Load tests: synthetic delta streams with key churn to validate batching efficiency and GPU utilization across burst patterns.
Chaos tests: kill worker mid-chunk, corrupt a checkpoint entry, and validate recovery decisions by conciliator.
Compatibility tests: bulk backfill converted to delta-stream job must produce identical final vectors as legacy bulk-import path.
Security tests: ensure idempotency metadata access respects workspace RBAC and no PII is written in audit blobs.
monitoring_and_metrics: alerts: checkpoint_lag_seconds > 300 for any active job -> page SRE
SLOs: 99% of job commits within 30s of final chunk arrival for non-backfill jobs.
potential_risks: Checkpoint store write amplification under many small shards — mitigate via compaction and write coalescing.
Incorrect dedupe key construction could drop legitimate updates — require strict test coverage and canary verification.
Late-arrival reconciliation could cause unexpected vector state flips for users who expect last-write-wins; document behavior and provide transform hooks.
Cost blowup if batching windows are too small during high-cardinality hotkeys — expose adaptive window tuning and default safe ceiling.
Operational complexity: adding conciliator and checkpointing increases operational surface; provide runbooks and emergency cancel/resume tools.
api_examples:
Send chunk (Python snippet): from redwood import DeltaStreamClient
client.append_chunk(job_id, shard=3, chunk_sequence=42, records=[{"id":"p1", "source_ts":"2026-03-01T12:00:00Z", "operation":"upsert", "payload": {...}, "idempotency_key":"idp-xyz"}])
Resume after restart: GET /v1/embeddings/delta-stream/{job_id}/checkpoint -> returns last checkpoint per shard; worker resumes at next sequence.
